articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can simultaneously process and cross-reference code repositories, visual diagrams, and spoken instructions in a single inference pass. The model demonstrates significant improvements in long-horizon planning tasks and reduced hallucination rates, with benchmarks showing a 34% improvement on SWE-Bench over its predecessor. Enterprise API pricing has been reduced by 40% compared to the original GPT-5 release earlier this year.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves New State-of-the-Art on Mathematical Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2 solved 89% of International Mathematical Olympiad problems from the past decade, surpassing the previous record of 78% set earlier in 2026. The breakthrough leverages a novel chain-of-verification architecture that allows the model to formally verify its own proof steps using an integrated Lean 4 theorem prover. The result signals a meaningful step toward AI systems capable of original mathematical research.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Now Performs Autonomous Warehouse Logistics in Commercial Pilot
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics began a commercial pilot program deploying its electric Atlas humanoid robot in DHL warehouse facilities across three U.S. locations, handling unstructured palletizing and mixed-SKU order picking. The robots operate fully autonomously for 16-hour shifts with a reported 99.2% pick accuracy, using on-board vision-language models for zero-shot object manipulation. This marks the first large-scale commercial deployment of a general-purpose humanoid in logistics.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C as Its Humanoid Robot Enters BMW Production Lines
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C round at a $15 billion valuation, fueled by early success in deploying its Figure 02 humanoid at BMW's Spartanburg plant for sub-assembly tasks. The robots use a foundation model trained on over 50,000 hours of teleoperation data and can learn new manipulation tasks from fewer than 10 demonstrations. The funding will accelerate scaling to additional automotive and electronics manufacturing partners in 2027.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional AI Monitoring Framework for Enterprise Deployments
articles.summary: Anthropic released an open-source framework called 'Claude Guard' that provides real-time constitutional AI monitoring for enterprise LLM deployments, enabling organizations to define domain-specific safety constitutions and audit model outputs at scale. The framework integrates with major orchestration platforms including LangChain and LlamaIndex, and includes automated red-teaming pipelines. Several Fortune 500 companies in finance and healthcare have already adopted it in production.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced that its N1.4 process node has entered volume production at its Fab 22 in Kaohsiung, approximately two months ahead of the original timeline. The node delivers a 20% performance gain and 30% power reduction over N2, utilizing gate-all-around nanosheet transistors with backside power delivery. Initial customers include Apple and Nvidia for next-generation mobile and data center processors expected to ship in early 2027.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface with Wireless Charging
articles.summary: Neuralink received FDA clearance for its N2 implant, which doubles the electrode count to 2,048 channels and introduces wireless inductive charging, eliminating the need for periodic surgical battery replacements. Early clinical trial data from 12 quadriplegic patients showed cursor control speeds approaching able-bodied mouse usage, with a mean information transfer rate of 8.5 bits per second. The approval opens recruitment for a 200-patient pivotal trial beginning in Q1 2027.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 with Mixture-of-Experts Architecture Rivaling GPT-5 on Key Benchmarks
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 under a permissive open-source license, featuring a 16-expert mixture-of-experts architecture that activates only 45B parameters per forward pass from a total of 400B. The model matches or exceeds GPT-5 on coding, reasoning, and multilingual benchmarks while running efficiently on a single 8xH100 node. The release includes fine-tuning recipes, RLHF datasets, and quantized variants optimized for on-device deployment on high-end consumer GPUs.
